name: Volume Raycasting with MRT Endpoints
definition: A technique to obtain ray start and stop positions for volume raycasting by rendering a cube into two floating-point RGB surfaces using a fragment shader that writes object-space coordinates. Front faces go into one attachment, back faces into the other.
summary: Volume Raycasting with MRT Endpoints is a two-pass GPU technique that determines ray entry and exit points by rendering a bounding box to multiple render targets, avoiding analytical intersection calculations.
